en.headline: CENTRESTAGE runs through Saturday at the convention centre
en.dek: The 11th edition of the HKTDC fashion fair is open free to adults who pre-register, with about 270 brands from 24 countries and regions on show until 5 September.
body: CENTRESTAGE, the annual fashion fair organised by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council, continues today at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre and closes on Saturday. The 11th edition opened on Wednesday and is open to industry buyers and members of the public aged 18 or above who complete pre-registration.

The HKTDC said this year’s fair has drawn about 270 brands from 24 countries and regions, a record for the event, arranged across zones including Craftsmanship, Contemporary, Urban, Athleisure, Circular Fashion and Accessories. The programme is a flagship of Hong Kong Fashion Fest and is sponsored by the government’s Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency.

Hours today are 10am to 7pm. Saturday runs from 10am to 6pm. The Hong Kong Tourism Board lists admission as free, with pre-registration required through the official fair site. The venue is at 1 Expo Drive, Wan Chai, with the Harbour Road entrance specified by the organiser.
An online sourcing platform attached to the fair remains open until 1 October, the HKTDC said, after the physical exhibition ends.

zh.headline: 香港國際時尚匯展今明兩日繼續 週六閉幕
zh.dek: 貿發局主辦的第11屆CENTRESTAGE於會展舉行至9月5日，約370個來自24個國家及地區品牌參展，18歲或以上事先登記可免費入場。
body: 香港貿易發展局主辦的年度時尚展CENTRESTAGE今日繼續在香港會議展覽中心舉行，週六閉幕。第11屆展覽週三開幕，正式豹豹及18歲或以上市民須事先登記才可入場。
貿發局表示，今年約370個品牌來自24個國家及地區參展，為歷屆最多，分為工藝、當代、都市、運動休閒、循環時尚及配飾等展區。活動屬香港時尚祭旗艦節目，由文化創意產業發展處贊助。
今日開放時間為上午10時至下午7時，週六為上午10時至下午6時。香港旅遊發展局列明入場免費，但須透過展覽官網預先登記。場地為灣仔博覽道1號，主辦單位指明由港灣道入口進場。
貿發局表示，配套的線上採購平台在實體展結束後仍開放至10月1日。
